violations.text: Firm did not have a person at time of inspection who has completed an approved food safety manager course. Firm must enroll additional employees in a food safety manager course or schedule an employee to be there at all times. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Firm's QR code for nutritional and allergen information for Johnsonville products is broken. The PERMIT HOLDER shall notify CONSUMERS by written notification of the presence of MAJOR FOOD ALLERGENS as an ingredient in unPACKAGED FOOD items that are served or sold to the CONSUMER. Firm placed book with required information next to hot roller. Firm must fix QR code. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2024
The ice bagging area (considered an area of prep) is lacking a hand-washing sink. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2024

Staff failed to sanitize equipment and utensils after washing and rinsing them. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2024
